\section{Antenna Grounding}\label{sec:m:ground}
The antenna ground system consists of a copper ground ring around the
mast base, eight driven rods bonded to the ring, and a single-point
ground bar inside the transmitter building. All outdoor connections use
exothermic welds; clamp connections are not accepted outdoors.

The ring resistance is measured each spring with a fall-of-potential
tester and must read below 5~ohms. Readings between 5 and 25~ohms
require two additional rods; readings above 25~ohms are reported to the
committee before any further work is scheduled.

Lightning protection on the feed line is inspected at the same visit.
The surge arrestor is replaced every three years regardless of its
condition, and the replacement date is painted on the arrestor body.

\section{Transmitter Servicing}
The transmitter is serviced twice a year. The spring visit combines the
filter change with the grounding inspection described in
Section~\ref{sec:m:ground}; the autumn visit focuses on the cooling
path and the standby exciter.

Filter elements are replaced, not cleaned. Reflected power is logged at
the start and end of every visit, and any reading above 4~percent of
forward power triggers a feed-line sweep before the site is left
unattended.

\section{Daily Checks}
The duty operator completes the daily check list before sign-on:
transmitter telemetry within limits, studio clock against the time
signal, EAS receiver status lamp green, and the telephone hybrid tested
with a call to the answering service.

Any failed check is written on the whiteboard and reported to the
programme director before the first scheduled segment. A failed EAS
lamp keeps the station off air until the receiver is confirmed working.

\section{Studio Etiquette}
The studio is a working room, not a lounge. Presenters arrive twenty
minutes before their slot, guests sign the visitor sheet, and food
stays outside the control room. Drinks are allowed only in lidded cups
on the outer desk.

Headphones are wiped after each use, and faders are left at the marked
home positions. The last presenter of the day runs the shutdown card
and texts the duty operator.

instruction: 电台手册结构调一下：maintenance.tex 里的 Antenna Grounding 整节（标题带正文）挪到 operations.tex，放在 Daily Checks 前面，内容一个字别改；它的 label 跟着新家走，改成 sec:ops:ground，main.tex 和 maintenance.tex 里引用这节的地方同步改，别留断引用；main.tex 里两个 \input 的顺序也换过来，operations 在前 maintenance 在后。

dialogue.persona: 社区电台值班技师，中文交流，半懂 LaTeX，能看懂 \section、\ref、\input；干事利落，要求一次说完，验收时逐条核对。
dialogue.hiddenGoal: 终态（三目标同时满足才算完）：① Antenna Grounding 整节在 operations.tex 且位于 Daily Checks 之前，三节正文逐字未动；maintenance.tex 只剩 Transmitter Servicing 一节，Antenna Grounding 字样消失；② label 改名 \label{sec:ops:ground}，main.tex 里一处 \ref 和 maintenance.tex 里一处 \ref 都指向新名，旧名 sec:m:ground 全文 0 残留；③ main.tex 的 \input 顺序为 operations 在前、maintenance 在后；项目仍是 3 个文件，编译通过无 ??。剧本：第 1 轮（instruction）三个要求一次说清。之后用户逐条验收，哪个没做到点哪个：若节挪了但引用没跟上（PDF 有 ??），说"引用还是断的，自己全局搜一遍 sec:m:ground"；若 \input 顺序没换，说"顺序还没换，我要先日常后保养"；若节内容被改写，说"内容别动，原样搬"；若 maintenance.tex 里旧节还在，说"旧文件里那节没删干净"。分岔：若 agent 一次全做对，用户抽查编译无 ?? 后确认结束；若 agent 只做了部分，用户按上面话术逐项追。知识边界：用户知道 \ref/\label 机制和全局搜索，验收看 PDF 引用编号、目录顺序和搜索结果。
